mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_resource_quota (id, project_id, resource_pool_id, spec_id, total_nodes, used_nodes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{resourcePoolId}, #{specId}, #{totalNodes}, #{usedNodes}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE project_resource_quota SET total_nodes = #{totalNodes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE project_resource_quota SET used_nodes = #{usedNodes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM project_resource_quota WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId} AND spec_id = #{specId}

SELECT prq.id, prq.project_id, prq.resource_pool_id, prq.spec_id, prq.total_nodes, prq.used_nodes, (prq.total_nodes - prq.used_nodes) AS available, cs.name AS spec_name, cs.spec_type, cs.pool_type, rp.name AS pool_name, rp.pool_type AS rp_pool_type FROM project_resource_quota prq JOIN compute_spec cs ON cs.id = prq.spec_id JOIN resource_pool rp ON rp.id = prq.resource_pool_id WHERE prq.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY rp.pool_type, cs.name

SELECT prq.id, prq.project_id, prq.resource_pool_id, prq.spec_id, prq.total_nodes, prq.used_nodes, (prq.total_nodes - prq.used_nodes) AS available, cs.name AS spec_name, cs.spec_type, cs.pool_type, rp.name AS pool_name, rp.pool_type AS rp_pool_type FROM project_resource_quota prq JOIN compute_spec cs ON cs.id = prq.spec_id JOIN resource_pool rp ON rp.id = prq.resource_pool_id WHERE prq.project_id = #{projectId} AND rp.pool_type = #{poolType} ORDER BY cs.name
